children: SD Guthrie's 4Q core net profit could be 6% lower on quarter at 774 million ringgit, says CIMB Securities analyst Ivy Ng Lee Fang in a note. This is because provision write-backs are not expected to recur, while lower crude palm oil prices and production are likely to weigh on plantation earnings, she says. These headwinds should be partly offset by industrial land sales net profit of 290 million ringgit and 68 million ringgit in land compensation, she reckons. SD Guthrie guides crude palm oil prices could rise to 5,000 ringgit a ton in 2027. The higher CPO prices may cushion drought-related yield pressures, but regulatory risks in Indonesia add uncertainty. CIMB has a buy rating and target price of 6.52 ringgit on the stock, which is 0.7% lower at 5.96 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
